newsitem.title: USA: Ryder completes pact with British Airways.
newsitem.headline: Ryder completes pact with British Airways.

text.p: Ryder Systems Inc said its United Kingdom unit Ryder Plc completed a pact with British Airways Plc, which gives Ryder full responsibility for the airline's Ground Fleet Services operations in the U.K.

Included in the agreement is a contract for fleet management and maintenance services at Heathrow and Gatwick airports worth at least US$260 million or 160 million British Pounds over the first five years, the company said.

Ground Fleet Services provides fleet management and maintenance operations for British Airways and other airlines at Heathrow and Gatwick airports. The transfer of the operation to Ryder has been completed after four months of negotiations, the company said.
Of the 486 Ground Fleet Services employees previously working for British Airways, 415 will transfer to Ryder.

The company said the remainder have accepted offers of early retirement, voluntary severance or jobs elsewhere in British Airways. The contractual terms and conditions of employment for transferring staff will not be affected.
